title: Billing and Coding: Amniotic and Placental-Derived Product Injections and/or Applications for Musculoskeletal Indications, Non-Wound

codes.1: Note : Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the HCPCS codes in their HCPCS book. Consistent with the LCD, all of the following HCPCS codes are non-covered when reported for musculoskeletal indications, non-wound.

covered.1: It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted.
